title: Digital Marketing Strategist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Quantiv Media is a full\-funnel digital marketing agency built to unite high\-performing campaigns with standout creative work. The team focuses on measurable outcomes across brand strategy, content and social, performance marketing (Meta, Google, LinkedIn), SEO, web design, video production, marketing automation, and AI\-powered marketing. Every project is anchored in data, with clear hypotheses, KPIs, and reporting designed for stakeholders who care about both brand and P\&L. Quantiv Media partners with startups, SMEs, and enterprise teams across the UAE, India, and global markets. The agency’s culture emphasizes strategy\-first thinking, creative built to convert, and continuously optimized media.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Digital Marketing Strategist role based in Pune. The Digital Marketing Strategist will develop and refine data\-driven marketing strategies across the full funnel, from awareness to retention. Responsibilities include conducting market and audience research, defining campaign hypotheses and KPIs, and planning integrated initiatives across paid media, content, social, SEO, and marketing automation. The role involves overseeing campaign execution with creative and media teams, monitoring performance, and optimizing tactics weekly to improve reach, engagement, cost per lead, and conversion metrics. The strategist will also prepare clear performance reports, provide insights to clients and internal stakeholders, and help align marketing activities with broader business objectives.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in digital strategy, campaign planning, and funnel design, with experience connecting marketing initiatives to business KPIs and revenue outcomes.
* Hands\-on expertise in performance marketing across platforms such as Meta, Google, and LinkedIn, including budget management, bid strategies, targeting, and optimization.
* Experience with content and social media marketing, including briefing and evaluating creative, managing editorial calendars, and aligning messaging to audience behavior.
* Knowledge of SEO fundamentals and web marketing best practices, with the ability to collaborate on landing pages and websites optimized for conversion and search.
* Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM tools, using workflows, segmentation, and nurturing journeys to improve lead quality and retention.
* Ability to interpret analytics and reporting from tools such as Google Analytics, ad platform dashboards, and A/B testing software, turning data into actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex strategies clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated capability to work cross\-functionally with creative, media, and client teams in a fast\-paced, on\-site environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; relevant certifications in digital marketing or analytics are an advantage.
* Prior agency experience

* 8\+ years in marketing operations, campaign operations, or marketing automation

You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer\-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.

 What you'll own
   

  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product\-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.

Route product gaps to the product team, enablement gaps to Customer Success, and customer\-fit issues to the field deployment team.  all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.

 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. **What You'll Need:**

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** 




 The day\-to\-day responsibilities for an assistant marketing engineer in the aftermarket department are as follows:
 


1. Offer expert advice and support to external Sales Representatives,facilitating their success in the field.
2. Conduct detailed reviews of Bill of Materials (BOM), manufacturing drawings, and part specification documents to determine the correct replacement components needed for projects.
3. Analyze customer requests for quotes, and prepare and disseminate accurate quotations to representatives, end\-users, and intercompany customers for spare parts.
4. Verify that customer\-ordered parts meet the application's requirements to ensure compatibility and performance.
5. Process customer purchase orders by reviewing, approving, and entering them into the Pilot order management system.
6. Regular tracking of order production status in the Pilot order management system to ensure that orders are delivered on time.
7. Update the handled quotes/orders in the databases and generate a weekly report for facilitating project management.
8. Produce and dispatch order confirmations to customers, maintaining clear and professional communication.
9. Engage with Sales Representatives to guarantee seamless operations from order finalization to the shipment of products.
10. Handle change orders within the order management system, coordinating with operations and production engineering teams to implement required modifications.
11. Oversee the development and maintenance of parts list databases to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
12. Continuously assess market feedback to update and maintain a competitive product catalog.
13. Conduct on\-site customer visits when necessary, obtaining field measurements for component replication and equipment specification.
14. Facilitate collaboration with global Companysales, marketing, product development, and operations teams to align strategies and initiatives.
15. Investigate parts warranty issues in conjunction with the Quality Control team, customers, and representatives, executing quality assurance reviews within the Quality Management System (QMS).
16. Identify and document non\-conformity incidents, submitting comprehensive reports within the QMS to uphold quality standards and compliance.
17. Establish and adjust base gross margin values for different product categories, tracking sales to safeguard margin targets.
18. Contribute to the formulation and achievement of departmental success targets.
19. Continuously evaluate existing procedures and practices to enhance efficiency and achieve cost reductions.
20. Generate and distribute key marketing and strategic communications, including Replacement Sales Flashes.
21. Represent the company at industry events, engaging in frontline sales activities.
22. Actively engage in relevant industry events as necessitated by the company’s interests.
23. Promote and uphold stringent safety protocols within the workplace.
24. Persistently pursue cost containment and reduction strategies.
25. Foster a constructive and optimistic work environment, contributing to team morale and productivity.
26. Give product and company overview presentations when required.
27. Host Representatives, Customers, and Guests at Company’s manufacturing facilities as requested.
28. Provide back\-up coverage for Marketing Engineer during absence to ensure prompt customer support.


* Offer support and advice to external Sales Representatives and aid with order entry and product selection using Company's Spectrum software.
* Review technical specifications from customers and optimize equipment layouts for projects, ensuring adherence to Company guidelines and full performance to required thermal capacity.
* Analyze customer product selections and suggest alternative models to enhance layout, energy efficiency, pricing, and compliance with local standards.
* Provide product and technical training, as well as Spectrum software training to assigned Representatives
* Review, approve, and ensure all supporting order documentation is collected and uploaded to Company's Pilot order management system.
* Approve submittal documentation for accuracy, manage change orders, and alert operations and production engineering of required changes.
* Tracking order fulfillment and alerting logistics department for timely shipment.


1. Execute additional responsibilities and undertake projects aligned with the company’s ethos, as directed by Management.



  





**Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:** 




 To excel as an Assistant Marketing Engineer, a combination of technical savvy, real\-world experience, and interpersonal skills is essential. An engineering degree lays the technical groundwork, while experience in customer\-centric roles enhances understanding of market dynamics. Key abilities include attention to detail, effective communication, leadership, and time management, enabling efficient problem\-solving and project execution. Proficiency in English and the flexibility to travel are also vital for engaging with a global clientele. These skills are central to fostering innovation, driving sales, and securing the company's competitive edge. Therefore, a Marketing Engineer at Company must possess the following qualifications, skills and attributes:
 



  




1. **Educational Background:** 
 Possession of a university degree in an engineering discipline, such as HVAC, Mechanical Engineering, Power Engineering, or Environmental Engineering, is mandatory.
2. **Professional Experience:** 
 Preference will be given to candidates with experience in mechanical work, equipment sales, or roles that involve direct interaction with customers.
3. **Detail Orientation:** 
 Candidates must exhibit a meticulous approach to their work, demonstrating a keen attention to detail.
4. **Communication and Coordination Skills:** 
 Exceptional skills in coordination and communication are essential, enabling effective collaboration and information exchange.
5. **Leadership and Interpersonal Skills:** 
 Strong leadership qualities combined with excellent interpersonal skills are required to effectively manage and interact with diverse teams.
6. **Time Management:** 
 Proficiency in managing one's time efficiently is crucial, ensuring tasks and projects are completed within designated timelines.
7. **Multitasking and Responsiveness:** 
 The ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously and respond promptly is required.
8. **Problem\-Solving Skills:** 
 Possess independent thinking and problem\-solving skills. Candidates must be able to engage in quick, technical problem\-solving to address challenges effectively.
9. **Language Proficiency:** 
 Excellent command of the English language, both in written and oral form, is necessary.
10. **Travel Flexibility:** 
 The willingness and ability to travel both domestically and internationally are essential for this role. Candidates must also possess a passport and ability to obtain international visas
11. **Presentation Skills:** 
 The capability to construct and deliver technical product presentations in proficient English.

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:

**About the Role** 




  





 We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Generalist who wants to do more than make marketing plans.
 



  





 You’ll be one of the people shaping how
 **Plutas.ai and DigiSafe** 
**Insurance** 
 are seen, heard and remembered, from the content that appears on someone’s LinkedIn feed to the campaigns, events, stories and ideas that make people stop and pay attention.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who enjoys being
 **behind the scenes and in the middle of everything:** 
 spotting an opportunity, coming up with an idea, figuring out how to make it happen, and then watching it go live.
 



  





 You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, product and have the opportunity to build marketing initiatives from the ground up.
 



  





 If you’re someone who is naturally curious, has strong opinions about good content, understands what makes people engage, and likes turning ideas into action, we’d like to meet you.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




  





***Be the voice of the brand***




  





 \* Help shape and evolve the voice, personality and presence of
 **Plutas AI and DigiSafe Insurance** 
 .
 



 \* Create and manage content across LinkedIn, social media, websites, email and other relevant channels.
 



 \* Turn company updates, product developments, customer stories and industry conversations into content people actually want to read.
 



 \* Bring consistency to how our brands communicate, while keeping the communication human, relevant and current.
 



  





**Turn ideas into campaigns** 




  





 \* Conceptualise and execute marketing campaigns from idea to launch.
 



 \* Experiment with new formats, platforms, partnerships and ways of reaching our audience.
 



 \* Work with creative teams, agencies and internal stakeholders to bring campaigns to life.
 



 \* Take an idea from a WhatsApp conversation or whiteboard to something people see in the real world.
 



  





**Be close to the business** 




  





 \* Understand our products, customers and market deeply enough to tell compelling stories around them.
 



 \* Work closely with Sales and Product to understand what the business needs from marketing.
 



 \* Support demand generation, customer engagement and brand\-building initiatives.
 



 \* Identify opportunities where marketing can create a measurable business impact.
 



  





**Own our presence in the market** 




  





 \* Keep an eye on what is happening across AI, insurance, technology, consumer behaviour and the broader market.
 



 \* Spot conversations, trends and opportunities that our brands should be part of.
 



 \* Help build partnerships, events, activations and other initiatives that put the brands in front of the right people.
 



 \* Think beyond “posting content” \- think about \*\*how we become a brand people recognise and remember.\*\*
 



  





**Use data, but don’t lose the instinct** 




  





 \* Track campaign and content performance.
 



 \* Understand what is working, what isn't and why.
 



 \* Use data to improve campaigns, channels and content.
 



 \* Balance analytics with creativity, experimentation and good marketing judgment.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We’re
 **not** 
 looking for someone who only knows how to execute a predefined marketing calendar.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone who:
 



  





 \* Has 2–5 years of marketing experience, ideally in a startup, technology, insurance or other fast\-moving environment.
 



 \* Is genuinely interested in
 **brands, content, culture and consumer behaviour** 




 \* Has strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 \* Can write something that sounds like a human wrote it \- not a corporate template.
 



 \* Has a strong sense of what makes content interesting, relevant and shareable.
 



 \* Is comfortable working across content, social media, campaigns, events, partnerships and digital marketing.
 



 \* Can move comfortably between
 **big\-picture thinking and getting things done** 
 .
 



 \* Is comfortable with ambiguity and doesn't need every step mapped out.

 You see a campaign, LinkedIn post, brand or event and immediately think about why it worked.

 You don't wait for a brief to start thinking. You naturally spot opportunities and bring them to the table.

 You don't just say \*“we should do this.”\* You figure out how to make it happen.

 The headline, the visual, the timing, the tone — you know the little things matter.
 



  





**\*\*Are curious.\*\*** 




 You like learning about new industries, technologies, audiences and platforms.
 



  





**\*\*Have a point of view.\*\*** 




 You can say, \*“I don't think this will work — here's what we should do instead.”\*
 



  





**\*\*Enjoy building.\*\*** 




 You want to look back six months later and see something that exists because \*\*you built it.\*\*
 



  





***Come build the voice behind Plutas AI and DigiSafe Insurance.***

title: Senior Marketplaces Advertising Strategist..
description:
This is not a reporting seat or an execution\-only role. You will own the advertising performance of your accounts end\-to\-end — strategy, targets, partner relationship, and outcomes — and act as the eyes and ears of the ads function on the ground. That means proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and optimisation calls before partners or leadership have to ask, and translating what the data is telling us into decisions and action.
   

  

**You will work side\-by\-side with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead, supporting them to deliver against team\-level commercial targets while running your own book of accounts with autonomy. You will be hands\-on across Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and equally comfortable leading a partner conversation about commercial strategy as you are inside a bid management interface.**
 ₹0 \- ₹0 a year
   

  

**Account Ownership \& Strategy Leadership**
* Own a portfolio of strategic brand accounts end\-to\-end — you are the senior strategist accountable for advertising performance against agreed commercial targets (revenue, ROAS, TACoS, new\-to\-brand, share of voice)
* Define quarterly and monthly advertising strategies for each account, aligned to partner commercial goals — growth, profitability, launches, defence, and category share
* Lead the advertising conversation in partner meetings, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews — own the narrative on what happened, why, what we are doing next, and what to expect
* Be the eyes and ears of the ads function — proactively flag what is working, what is at risk, and what to do about it, ahead of partners or leadership asking
* Partner with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead to hit portfolio\-level targets; raise pacing, performance, and budget risks early and bring the recommended call, not just the problem


**Campaign Strategy \& Optimisation**
* Plan, execute, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Amazon (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and Amazon DSP for your strategic accounts
* Lead optimisation across the portfolio — campaign structure, keyword strategy, negatives, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget pacing
* Test, scale, and retire — design structured tests (bid, placement, creative, audience), interpret results with rigour, and roll winners into the playbook
* Plan and manage weekly and monthly advertising budgets across your accounts; keep spend on pace and on strategy
* Continuously improve the tracking of brand\-level ad spend and return on ad spend, and the way we report performance to partners


**Amazon Marketing Cloud, DSP \& Advanced Advertising**
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) as a core part of how you build strategy — path\-to\-conversion, audience overlap, incrementality, new\-to\-brand analysis
* Run and interpret Amazon DSP campaigns and analytics — quantify how upper\-funnel activity contributes to lower\-funnel conversions and feed that back into the plan
* Stay ahead of the Amazon advertising roadmap — beta features, new ad types, AMC releases — and bring the relevant ones into how we operate


**Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Communicate with partners via email, calls, and face\-to\-face meetings — bring insight, not just updates
* Define compelling advertising strategies that meet partner commercial goals and articulate them clearly to non\-specialist audiences
* Work closely with Brand Management, Merchandising, and SEO/Content to drive an aligned commercial agenda for your accounts — advertising is one lever, not the whole story


**Team \& Function**
* Train, develop, and coach more junior strategists and the offshore execution team — quality\-check work, raise the bar on standards, and build playbooks others can reuse
* Support the Lead on partner escalations, portfolio reviews, and strategic initiatives across the team
* Adopt internal tools and feed requirements back to the tech team to make the team faster and sharper


**Must\-Have**
* 5\+ years of total experience, with 3\+ years in a hands\-on digital advertising role on Amazon — agency, accelerator, or in\-house at a meaningful scale
* Demonstrable track record of owning accounts and carrying performance targets — you have held a number and hit it, not just reported on one
* Deep working knowledge of the Amazon advertising ecosystem — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) — or strong fluency in clean\-room / advanced advertising analytics and willingness to certify within the first 90 days
* Line management or senior mentoring experience — you have raised the performance of people around you
* Strategic thinker with a strong commercial bias — you can connect a bid adjustment to a P\&L outcome and explain it to a non\-specialist
* Excellent verbal and written communication — you can lead a partner conversation and write a sharp performance narrative
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management and attention to detail
* Proactive and self\-directed — comfortable operating with autonomy across a portfolio and raising your hand before being asked


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with retail / ecommerce brands across multiple categories
* Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) certification
* Working knowledge of SQL for advertising data analysis
* Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight)

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**What We Do** 




 FlytBase builds the world's leading drone autonomy software, powering operations for 300\+ customers in 40\+ countries—including Fortune 500 companies like Xcel Energy, Airbus, and Anglo American. Check out some of our critical deployments here.
 



  





 Headquartered in California with a fast\-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is powering the shift from human\-operated to self\-driven skies. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team works in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI isn't a side project, it's the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As Product Marketing Manager at FlytBase, you'll be the bridge between what we build and how the market understands it. You'll own positioning and messaging across verticals—translating deep technical capabilities into language that resonates with enterprise buyers in energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure. You'll arm sales with materials that actually get used, turn customer wins into compelling proof points, and ensure every product launch lands with clarity and impact.
 



  





 This role lives in the messy middle between product, sales, and the market. You'll spend as much time talking to customers and prospects as you do with internal teams. You'll need to understand the technical details well enough to distill them into buyer language—which is why a background in drones, robotics, or a related technical field will help you ramp fast and earn credibility quickly.
 



  





 The right person for this role has sharp marketing instincts, genuine curiosity about the product, and the ability to context\-switch between a product spec doc and a sales call without missing a beat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 • Positioning and messaging—sharpening how FlytBase talks about itself across verticals, personas, and use cases. You'll define the narrative, not just document it.
 



 • Sales enablement—battlecards, pitch decks, one\-pagers, objection handling guides, and competitive comparisons. The stuff sales actually pulls up before a call.
 



 • Product launches—working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing to ensure new features and releases land with the right story, materials, and market awareness.
 



 • Competitive intelligence—tracking the landscape, understanding alternatives, and keeping sales and leadership informed on how we win (and where we're vulnerable).
 



 • Customer evidence—building a library of case studies, testimonials, and reference customers that make the value tangible.
 



 • Buyer and market research—understanding what enterprise buyers care about, how they evaluate solutions, and what's blocking deals.
 



 • Partner marketing—working with 50\+ integration partners to ensure co\-marketing efforts are consistent, accurate, and compelling.
 



  





**Best Suited For** 




 • 2\-4 years in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise tech, or technical products.
 



 • Drone, robotics, or electronics background strongly preferred. If you've worked in or around hardware, autonomous systems, or industrial tech, you'll hit the ground running.
 



 • At minimum, a technical background that lets you read a product spec, understand an integration, and translate it for a non\-technical buyer.
 



 • Experience working closely with sales—you understand deal cycles, objections, and what reps actually need to close.
 



 • Strong messaging instincts—you can take a complex technical differentiator and turn it into a sentence a buyer remembers.
 



 • Customer\-facing comfort—you'd rather be on a call with a customer or prospect than in an internal planning meeting.
 



 • Experience with AI tools for research, writing, and presentation creation is expected. You use them to move faster, not as a crutch.
 



  





**What Makes You a Flyter** 




 • Customer obsession: You learn more from one customer call than from a week of internal meetings. You're always looking for excuses to talk to the market.
 



 • Sales partner, not sales support: You work with sales, not for them. You'll push back on bad messaging requests and propose better alternatives.
 



 • Clarity as craft: You believe good positioning is a competitive advantage. You sweat the words because you know a single sentence can change a deal.
 



 • Technical credibility: You can sit in a product review and follow along. Engineers and PMs respect your input because you've done the homework.
 



 • Launch discipline: You don't just announce features—you ensure the market understands why they matter and sales knows how to sell them.
 



 • Competitive awareness: You always know what the other players are saying and how we stack up. Not out of anxiety—out of clarity.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 




 • Marketers who treat sales enablement as a chore rather than a lever for revenue.
 



 • People who create decks and documents that sit in a folder and never get used.
 



 • PMMs who avoid direct customer contact and rely only on secondhand insights.
 



 • Anyone who needs a technical co\-pilot to understand what we're building. You should be able to get 80% of the way there yourself.
 



 • Folks who wait for product to hand them messaging instead of proposing it themselves.
 



 • "Process people" who need perfect inputs before they can create outputs. If you can't handle ambiguity, this isn't the place.
 



  





**Why FlytBase?** 




 • H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
 



 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
 



 • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
 



 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
 



 • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
 



  





**The Perks** 




 • High agency team and sense of purpose
 



 • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet)
 



 • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
 



 • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
 



 • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
 



 • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most
 



 • Top\-tier health coverage for you
 



 • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)

description:
The Senior Marketing Analyst, Reporting \& Insights is the senior measurement and reporting owner for Showpad's marketing organization. This person is trusted to take a reporting question from ambiguous, scattered data all the way to an accurate, board\-ready answer and to stand behind every number.
   

  

 Beyond building dashboards, this role identifies where the data actually lives across our platforms, leads the effort to bring the right data into Salesforce as the system of record, and builds reliable reporting from there. It is also an early adopter of AI: using tools such as Claude Cowork to automate recurring reporting and manual data preparation, while holding a high bar for accuracy. The goal is to convert repetitive, manual work into trustworthy automation so the team can spend its time solving business problems and mastering the platforms — not assembling spreadsheets.
   

  

 This is a role for a self\-directed go\-getter who is comfortable operating with ambiguity, figuring out who owns the answer to a question, and chasing it down across teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Board \& Executive Reporting**
* Own recurring board\-, QBR\-, and Marketing Leadership\-level reporting: pipeline, funnel performance, campaign effectiveness, channel performance, ROMI, and marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Translate complex, multi\-source data into clear, accurate, executive\-ready narratives and dashboards for the CMO, Senior Director of Marketing Operations, and board\-level discussions.
* Prepare inputs for board decks, planning cycles, and business reviews, and be accountable for the accuracy of every figure presented.
* Establish QA and validation routines so executive reporting reconciles consistently across systems and can be trusted without re\-checking.


**Cross\-Source Data Identification \& Salesforce Integration**
* Identify and map the data required for reporting across multiple platforms — Marketo, Salesforce, product usage, web analytics (GA4\), ABM/intent, enrichment, and finance systems.
* Lead the charge to get the right marketing\-level data into Salesforce as the system of record — defining fields, objects, mappings, and integration requirements in partnership with Revenue Operations.
* Own reporting from Salesforce once data lands, ensuring metric definitions and funnel\-stage logic are consistent end to end.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies, sync errors, and gaps across the Marketo\-to\-Salesforce integration and connected systems.


**AI\-Enabled Reporting \& Automation**
* Use AI tools (Claude Cowork or similar) to automate recurring reporting requests and manual data\-preparation work.
* Design automation with accuracy built in — source\-of\-truth checks, validation, and human QA — so speed never comes at the cost of trust in the numbers.
* Continuously convert manual, repetitive reporting tasks into reliable automated workflows, reinvesting the reclaimed time into deeper analysis, platform mastery, and business problem\-solving.
* Share AI\-enabled reporting practices with the broader marketing team and help raise the team's overall automation maturity.


**Performance Measurement \& Attribution**
* Build, maintain, and optimize marketing dashboards in Salesforce and visualization tools.
* Own and refine attribution models (multi\-touch/single\-touch) that evaluate marketing's influence on revenue.
* Ensure funnel definitions and stage movements are accurate and consistent across the tech stack.


**Strategic Insights \& Optimization**
* Conduct diagnostic analyses (cohort, funnel, segmentation, content and channel performance) to explain the “why” behind the numbers.
* Analyze spend efficiency to advise leadership on where to invest, optimize, or pull back across channels.
* Support revenue modeling, forecasting, and scenario planning in partnership with Revenue Operations and Finance.


**Data Governance \& Stakeholder Navigation**
* Maintain documentation for metric definitions, naming conventions, and data taxonomy to keep the organization aligned; recommend improvements to marketing data architecture.
* Operate as a self\-directed go\-getter: proactively determine who owns the answer to a question and pursue it across Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, and IT until resolved.
* Act as the go\-to expert for interpreting marketing data and enables the team to read dashboards and self\-serve.


**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience preparing board\- or executive\-level marketing reporting, including ownership of accuracy.
* Experience with ARR, pipeline, and funnel reporting in B2B SaaS.
* Advanced Salesforce reporting, with proven experience bringing data from multiple sources into Salesforce (field/object design, integrations) and building reporting from it.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools (Claude Cowork or similar) to automate reporting or analysis while maintaining reporting accuracy.
* Strong technical grasp of the Lead\-to\-Revenue funnel, including conversion rates, velocity, and multi\-touch attribution logic.
* Proficiency with data visualization tools (AWS QuickSight preferred) and Google Suite.
* Hands\-on experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred) and how they integrate with CRM and web analytics (GA4 preferred).
* Exceptional data storytelling: the ability to turn complex findings into clear, “so\-what” narratives for executive audiences.

* Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity — able to figure out who to talk to and drive to answers without being handed the path.
